operation.summary: Set how often the paid model audits the free stage's answers for this watch

body.name: audit_share
body.description: Share of free answers to audit, 0.005-0.5 (default 0.02); null resets it. Below 0.005 is refused: the audit is how misses are measured. Audits are paid and stay under max_paid_per_hour and the budget

operation.returns: watch_id, audit_share, audit_share_set, audit_share_default, audit_share_min, audit_share_max, keep_days, max_records
